observations.detail: This scheduled KONTUR execution could open and read the existing OWNER_OVERRIDE_G1, PLATFORM_CONTRACT_V0, RUN_PLATFORM_MEASUREMENTS_G1 and E7 task spec from File Library after exact-name navigation.
Non-semantic recent-upload navigation for 2026-08-20 exposed the E7 task spec plus the manifest and control objects created before this execution.

An exact filename lookup for FREE_FABRIC_BOOTSTRAP_V0_20260820.zip did not return the bootstrap object itself. This does not invalidate the existing durable-roundtrip proof in PLATFORM_CONTRACT_V0; it means direct path/filename retrieval of arbitrary Library objects is not proven by this surface.

No supported direct File Library write/version-replace action was available or exercised. PLATFORM_CONTRACT_V0 already marks library.versioned_write BLOCKED and scheduled.library_publish UNKNOWN; this run does not upgrade either capability.

safety.notes: Only assigned E7 work was performed. No CircleCI/GitHub Actions/provider traffic/product branch mutation.
